definitions.explanation: A commitment to do or not do something.
An arrangement to meet someone or do something at a specific time.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}を{守|まも}ってください。
{明日|あした}{約束|やくそく}があります。
{友達|ともだち}と{約束|やくそく}しました。
examples.english: I made plans with a friend.

notes: {約束|やくそく}する (to promise/make an appointment), {約束|やくそく}を{守|まも}る (to keep a promise), {約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}る (to break a promise). {約束|やくそく}の{時間|じかん} means 'the appointed time'.
